dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible in the mid-dorsal region; they feature irregular, crenulated outer perimeters where light-grey pixels transition sharply into a dark-grey interior core. The largest 'O' structure exhibits a jagged high-contrast boundary with a non-uniform width of the light-intensity ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, solid high-intensity (near-white) pixel clusters interspersed between the larger macro-annuli. These clusters lack an internal gradient and are most concentrated in the posterior-lateral quadrant, becoming more sparse towards the anterior neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest closed-loop macro-annuli in the central dorsal field form a near-equilateral triangle. A secondary alignment is observed where four smaller high-intensity blobs form a linear, descending chain toward the ventral boundary.
